about: Guest information for the free hotel list cards of the boards (js/hotel-list-card.js) and the full list in the phone app (app.html). Facts only: name, street address, phone, website, the logo where an official one reads on the cream column. No prices, no offers. Every field keeps the source it was read from and whether it was verified.
runtime: fids-current/data/hotels/yyz.json is made from this file by scripts/hotels/build-runtime.js: only the hotels that are listed and only the fields the cards and the phone app read. Edit this file, then run the script; tests/hotel-list-cards.test.js holds the two to agree.

rules.areas: downtown = within about 2 km of the centre point; airport = within about 5 km of the airport point; resort = a destination resort (resort true) more than 30 km from both points, listed with its drive distance (no tolerance); nearby = the rest within about 30 km of either point. Each about-limit has a 10 % tolerance; downtown is tested first, then airport.
rules.listed: listed false = held back (the reason is given). A listed hotel is shown only while its season is open (season.year_round, or a season.open range that holds the date at the airport).
rules.shuttle: shuttle.mark true only where the shuttle is verified on the hotel's or the airport's own page.
rules.logo: logo.file is loaded through , never inlined; opaque = the file has its own light ground (shown with a multiply blend on the cream column so the box does not show).
rules.logo_fill: logo.fill true = a stacked lockup whose words are small at the common logo height (62 px at 1680x1050): it may take the whole cell of the cream column, the width of the column and the height of its line. The file is shown as it is.

transit.note: Held (verified false), so the build step leaves it off the airport page: the hub rule asks for each fact on the operator’s own page, and the operator of the Link train, the airport (torontopearson.com), is blocked, needs a person. Read only: Terminals 1 and 3 from the operator of the UP Express; free, 24 h and every 4 to 8 minutes from Alt Hotel’s own pages. Those pages also show the train reaching only Viscount station, where the Alt Hotel is (its last stop), not the other airport hotels: a line for the whole area would read as a free train to all of them. A person who reads the operator’s page decides whether it comes back, and whether it belongs to the area or to the Alt Hotel alone. No readable page lists the three stops in order. No general hotel-shuttle pick-up point is verified: shuttle pick-up stays per hotel.

notes.verified_definition: verified true = read directly on 2026-11-22 on at least one official page: the hotel’s own site, its brand property page (including the Accor pages all.accor.com and Four Seasons’ own press room for the hotel), or the official tourism booking listing of Destination Toronto (stay.destinationtoronto.com, see unverified), and no official page read says otherwise; the quote is the page’s own words. Where one official page alone gives a fact, the hotel’s notes say so (one page is enough, as in the other cities). verified false = not read (403, a bot wall, a JS shell or no answer), on no official page, only on an owner group’s portfolio site (Easton’s, Manga, Silver Hotel Group: not one of the four official sources), or official pages that disagree: the note says which. OpenStreetMap only found the hotels (scripts/hotels/find-candidates.js); its positions are kept for the area distances, with its credit, and no fact rests on it alone. Each fact was checked twice: a first pass and an adversarial re-check, then a second pass on the hotels held back.
notes.postal_note: Postal codes are not shown on the cards. A postal code is marked verified true only where two official pages agree. Where the pages disagree (Kimpton Saint George, The Sutton Place, The Beverley) or none prints one, it is left empty or marked verified false.
notes.shuttle_note: shuttle.mark true = the card shows the shuttle mark, only where the hotel’s own page says so (the airport’s own page, torontopearson.com, is blocked): Sandman Signature Toronto Airport and Mississauga (free, 24 hours), and Woodbine Hotel and Suites (PAID, "a nominal fee"; held, still trading?). Best Western Premier Toronto Airport Carlingview names a free 24/7 shuttle on a brand page that answered 403 (excluded, blocked). A shuttle named only on the tourism listing (Hyatt Place) or an owner group’s site (Fairfield, TownePlace) is not marked. The Alt Hotel uses the airport’s free Link train, not a shuttle (hub.areas.airport, held: its operator’s page is blocked). shuttle.offered is true / false / null (unknown), shuttle.terms what the page says to do, shuttle.evidence the words read.
notes.season_note: season.year_round true = open all year. season.verified true only where a page says in words that the hotel is open all year: no Toronto page does. Two pages say "all year" of something else, kept in season.note as support only: Fairmont Royal York’s offers block ("Available all year-round", of an offer) and Windsor Arms’ tea rooms ("every day of the year"). Everywhere year_round true is the city-hotel default (verified false), recorded with the page that shows the hotel taking bookings or running round the clock and no closure (season.note quotes it), as Chateau Bedford in yhz.json. Kimpton Saint George and Four Seasons Hotel Toronto rest on the default with no such line beyond their booking buttons or opening date.
sources: Hotels’ own sites and brand property pages, read directly with WebFetch on 2026-11-22 (each fact’s source names the page)
Accor: all.accor.com property pages A551 and 0931, read directly; the Accor catalog response (catalog/v1/hotels, the feed of the board’s Accor pages) beside them for the Novotel position
Destination Toronto hotel booking listings, stay.destinationtoronto.com (each listing page read directly; see unverified)
UP Express (upexpress.com) and Alt Hotel’s own pages for the transit lines of hub
